title: [MTR4] Hankyu 1000 Series | 阪急1000系
description: Hankyu 1000 Series for Minecraft Transit Railway.
body:
The Hankyu 1000 series is a commuter electric multiple unit (EMU) operated by private railway operator Hankyu Railway on the Kobe and Takarazuka Main Lines. Introduced in 2013, it was based on the earlier 9000 and 9300 series trains with a slightly modified design. The train features permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) in its traction system, improving its energy efficiency compared to its predecessors. A derivative of the 1000 series operates on the Kyoto Main Line and its branches with alternate car body dimensions and different traction equipment, called the 1300 series.

This resource pack adds the Hankyu 1000 series to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod.

There are four types of cars for this train and you may configure them as you wish.

- Cab forwards
- Pantograph trailer
- Trailer
- Cab backwards
